sections.subheadline: Details on our technical processes, garment handling, and typical service timelines.

items.question: What is the typical turnaround time for standard dry cleaning?
items.answer: Most general wear garments are processed and ready for pickup within 24 to 48 hours. Items requiring extensive spot treatment or delicate handling may take slightly longer to ensure safety.

items.question: Can you successfully remove set-in wine or oil stains?
items.answer: Our technicians utilize a multi-stage diagnostic approach to stains. While success depends on the fabric and how long the stain has sat, our dedicated pre-treatment lifts the vast majority of severe localized stains.

items.question: Do you offer tailored pressing without full chemical cleaning?
items.answer: Yes. If an item simply needs structural restoration or wrinkle elimination, we offer standalone steam tensioning and hand-pressing services.

items.question: Is your facility equipped for alterations and tailoring repairs?
items.answer: Absolutely. Alongside cleaning, our team can handle hems, zipper replacements, and precise tailoring adjustments to optimize your garment's fit.
